610 Rogers Street
Temple, TX 76504
$189,995  
3 Beds 2 Full Bath 1116 sq ft 
This charming Single-Story brick home brings coziness and comfort together! Upon entering, you will find the open concept with the living/kitchen and dining room. The interior is light and functional with window treatments, pantry and 2 full sized baths with tub/shower combos. With Central Heat & AC, the home ensures comfortable year-round living. Parking is convenient with a one-car attached garage. Centrally located in Temple, you are minutes from all the amenities of Downtown Dining and Scott & White! The home is currently tenant occupied but allows for easy showings and tenant lease expires 9/30/2025! Make your appointment to see it!
